fullPassage: Self-Driving Cars Cars are now making steps toward their own kind of freedom; that is, freedom from people. The goal is to build a car that uses artificial intelligence so that it thinks and drives like a human. The technology for a self-driving car has reached the point where it is becoming increasingly accessible. Self-driving cars have clear advantages. Most of all, sitting behind the wheel would no longer be limited by age or ability. For example, a person who has lost sight could rely on a self-driving car to go from one place to another. Furthermore, most accidents are caused by careless people on the road. For example, many crashes are caused by people using their phones while driving, falling asleep at the wheel, or driving while drunk. With a self-driving car, people would not need to worry about such situations on the road. However, there are also some serious concerns when it comes to the safety of self-driving cars, since the technology is still far from perfect. In fact, a self-driving car depends only on its sensors, GPS, and computer programs to work properly. If any of these broke down or were used for unintended purposes, then the safety and security of the rider as well as other people on the road could be put at risk.

questions.passage: Self-Driving Cars Cars are now ①<u>making</u> steps toward their own kind of freedom; that is, freedom from people.  The goal is to build a car that ②<u>uses</u> artificial intelligence so that it thinks and drives like a human.  The technology for a self-driving car has reached the point ③<u>which</u> it is becoming increasingly accessible.  Self-driving cars have clear advantages.  Most of all, sitting behind the wheel would no longer be ④<u>limited</u> by age or ability.  For example, a person who has lost sight could rely on a self-driving car to go from one place to another.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① making: 'Cars are now making steps'에서 be동사(are)+현재분사(-ing)의 현재진행형으로 적절
✅ ② uses: 주격 관계대명사 that의 선행사 a car(단수)에 수 일치한 현재시제 동사로 적절
❌ ③ which → where: 'the point ___ it is becoming ~'에서 뒤에 완전한 절이 오므로 지점을 받는 관계부사 where가 옳다. 뒤에 불완전한 절이 와야 하는 관계대명사 which는 부적절 ←정답
✅ ④ limited: 'would no longer be limited by'에서 조동사+수동태(be p.p.)로 적절
det.tip: 뒤에 주어·동사가 모두 갖춰진 완전한 절이 오면 관계대명사 which가 아니라 관계부사 where를 씁니다.

questions.passage: Self-Driving Cars Cars are now making steps toward their own kind of freedom; that is, freedom from people. Most of all, ③<u>sitting</u> behind the wheel would no longer be limited by age or ability.  For example, a person who has lost sight could rely on a self-driving car ④<u>going</u> from one place to another.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① to build: 'The goal is to build ~'에서 be동사의 보어로 쓰인 to부정사로 적절
✅ ② becoming: 'it is becoming increasingly accessible'에서 현재진행형으로 적절
✅ ③ sitting: 'sitting behind the wheel would ~'에서 문장의 주어 역할을 하는 동명사로 적절
❌ ④ going → to go: 'rely on a self-driving car ___ from one place to another'에서 '~하기 위해'라는 목적을 나타내는 to부정사 to go가 옳다. 동명사 going은 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: '~하기 위해'라는 목적을 나타낼 때는 동명사(V-ing)가 아니라 to부정사(to+동사원형)를 씁니다.

questions.passage: Furthermore, most accidents ①<u>is caused</u> by careless people on the road.  For example, many crashes are caused by people ②<u>using</u> their phones while driving, falling asleep at the wheel, or driving while drunk.  With a self-driving car, people would not need to ③<u>worry</u> about such situations on the road.  However, there are also some serious concerns when it comes to the safety of self-driving cars, since the technology is still far from perfect.  In fact, a self-driving car ④<u>depends</u> only on its sensors, GPS, and computer programs to work properly.  If any of these broke down or were used for unintended purposes, then the safety and security of the rider as well as other people on the road could be put at risk.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① is caused → are caused: 주어 most accidents(복수)에 맞춰 복수형 be동사 are를 쓴 수동태 are caused가 옳다. 단수형 is caused는 수 일치를 어겨 부적절 ←정답
✅ ② using: 'people using their phones'에서 people을 뒤에서 수식하는 현재분사로 적절
✅ ③ worry: 'would not need to worry'에서 to부정사의 동사원형 worry로 적절
✅ ④ depends: 주어 a self-driving car(단수)에 맞춘 현재시제 동사 depends로 적절
det.tip: 주어가 복수(accidents)이면 수동태의 be동사도 복수형 are를 씁니다.

If any of these broke down or were used for unintended purposes, then the safety and security of the rider as well as other people on the road could ④<u>be putting</u> at risk.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① falling: 'using ~, falling asleep ~, or driving ~'에서 앞의 동명사들과 병렬을 이루는 falling으로 적절
✅ ② there are: 유도부사 there 구문에서 뒤의 주어 some serious concerns(복수)에 수 일치한 are로 적절
✅ ③ its: a self-driving car를 받아 sensors를 수식하는 소유격 대명사 its로 적절
❌ ④ be putting → be put: 주어 the safety and security가 '위험에 처하게 되는' 대상이므로 조동사 could 뒤에 수동태 be put이 옳다. 능동형 be putting은 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: 조동사(could) 뒤에서 주어가 동작을 '당하는' 의미이면 수동태 be+p.p.(be put)를 씁니다.

det.analysis:
✅ ① human: '인간처럼 생각하고 운전한다'는 문맥에서 human(인간)이 적절
✅ ② accessible: '기술이 점점 더 접근 가능해진다'는 문맥에서 accessible(접근 가능한)이 적절
❌ ③ drawbacks → advantages: 뒤에 이어지는 '나이·능력 제한이 사라짐', '시력을 잃은 사람도 이동 가능' 등이 모두 이점이므로 clear advantages(분명한 장점)가 맞다. '단점'을 뜻하는 drawbacks는 정반대라 부적절 ←정답
✅ ④ ability: '나이나 능력에 제한받지 않는다'는 문맥에서 ability(능력)가 적절
det.tip: 뒤따르는 예시가 모두 긍정적 이점이므로 '장점(advantages)'이 문맥에 맞습니다.

det.analysis:
✅ ① careless: '대부분의 사고는 부주의한 사람들 때문'이라는 문맥에서 careless(부주의한)가 적절
❌ ② sober → drunk: 사고를 일으키는 위험 행동을 나열하는 문맥이므로 '술에 취한' drunk가 맞다. '술 취하지 않은'을 뜻하는 sober는 정반대라 부적절 ←정답
✅ ③ worry: '그런 상황을 걱정할 필요가 없다'는 문맥에서 worry(걱정하다)가 적절
✅ ④ risk: '위험에 처할 수 있다'는 문맥에서 put at risk(위험에 처하다)의 risk가 적절

위 글의 내용을 바탕으로, 다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

'대부분의 사고는 부주의한 사람들에 의해 일어난다.'

[조건]
(1) accidents, are, by, careless, caused, most, people를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- most accidents(주어) + are caused(수동태 동사) + by careless people(행위자): '대부분의 사고는 부주의한 사람들에 의해 일어난다'
- 'be동사 + p.p. + by'의 수동태 구조로 동작의 주체를 by 뒤에 나타냈다.
det.tip: '~에 의해 …되다'는 수동태 be+p.p.와 행위자를 나타내는 by를 함께 씁니다.
